sentences.en: When air dries, the throat dries, and cough comes out.
sentences.zh: 空气干燥时，喉咙会干燥，从而引发咳嗽。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever coughed this much.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次咳这么多。

sentences.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
sentences.zh: 咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠时要捂住嘴。

senses.zh: 咳嗽；咳出；突然发出刺耳的声音；厉声说出；供认
